title: Closing the Business box from a sub-screen drops the parent screen's draft unsaved
trigger: Business > Opening Hours, toggle days / change zone, open a weekday (Day) or the time zone list, press Esc or click the backdrop. Same from the recipients Picker (Greeting/Away/Chatbots) or the sticker picker (Start Page).
effect: close_business_saving runs business_leave for the current view only; Day/TimeZone/Picker/StickerPick/LinkEdit are not saves_on_leave, so Go(None) and close_business drops hours/greeting/away/chatbot/start_page drafts. Closing from the parent screen would have saved. Edits vanish with no note.
fix: Make business_leave walk up View::parent chain (save the nearest saving ancestor) or hold a stack of screens whose drafts each save on close.

title: Save error of a Business screen is lost when the box is closed right after leaving it
trigger: Business > Greeting, change and Back (save sent, hub shows 'Saving'), press Close before TDLib answers; TDLib refuses.
effect: The refusal goes to settings.business.error, drawn only inside the Business box. close_business_saving(true) closes at once on the hub and open_business clears the error, so the user never learns the save failed; the draft is gone too.
fix: Surface a failed save as a StatusNote when the box is closed (or keep Close disabled while saving is non-empty); one Save stage enum per screen.

title: 'Chat link saved.' shown before TDLib answers; a refused create/edit keeps the success note and loses the draft
trigger: Links to Chat > New link, fill it, Save when the link limit is reached or the server refuses.
effect: save_business_link goes back to the list and sets note 'Chat link saved.' as soon as the request is queued (doc says 'once TDLib answers'). The failure arrives later as a separate red line, the note stays, and the typed message/name draft (link_edit) is gone.
fix: Keep the LinkEdit view in a Saving stage (enum) until the apply_chat_link / error answer; show the note only on the ok arm.

title: ChatbotDraft holds a stage as loaded bool + committed Option + confirm_leave bool + warning Option
trigger: Open Chat Automation.
effect: loaded/confirm_leave are hand-kept stage flags; loaded is filled from session.connected_bot and the screen polls every 200 ms (business_bot_watch) to copy it. Not a bug today beyond the entry below.
fix: enum ChatbotStage { Loading, Failed(String), Editing{..}, ConfirmLeave{..} }; drop the polling by applying the answer in the reducer.

title: Failed getBusinessConnectedBot leaves 'Loading…' forever with no Retry
trigger: Chat Automation opened while getBusinessConnectedBot fails (offline / server error other than 404).
effect: apply error sets connected_bot_requested=false; business_bot_pump reads that as failed, returns done and stops watching, but draft.loaded stays false so the body shows only 'Loading…' (business_waits_for_info excludes Chatbots, so no Retry button). Only leaving and re-entering retries. Also: failure is inferred from a bool going false, and SaveConnectedBot ok sets the same bool false, so the same signal means 'failed' and 'refetch wanted'.
fix: Make connected_bot a Fetch<Option<ConnectedBot>> (idle/loading/ready/failed) and draw the error with Retry like business_info_error.

title: Bot lookup results shown for a stale query while the new text is debounced
trigger: Chat Automation, type a username, wait for results, then keep typing.
effect: business_found_bots checks only that lookup.query is non-empty, not that it equals the typed text; for up to 400 ms (and the request round trip) the old query's bots are listed as hits for the new text, with live Add buttons, and the leave-confirm ('No bot added') is decided on them.
fix: Compare parse_username_query(text) with lookup.query; treat a mismatch as Found::Loading.

title: Saving hours silently replaces the saved time zone with the closest one when the saved id is missing from TDLib's list
trigger: Hours were saved with a zone id absent from getTimeZones; open Business Hours, change only a weekday, leave.
effect: business_zone() falls back to closest_time_zone and save_business_hours prefers it over draft.time_zone_id, so wanted != base on zone alone and a different zone is sent.
fix: Prefer the draft's saved id; use the closest zone only for a draft that had no zone.

title: Start page full-info fetch is re-sent on every render while the info is absent
trigger: Open an empty private chat with a user whose getUserFullInfo fails or never answers (deleted/restricted user), then move the mouse / any redraw.
effect: Comment says 'ask once' but no state records the ask: each render calls defer_screen -> fetch_user_full_info. It dedupes only while the request is pending or the info is stored; after an error nothing is stored, so each redraw sends the request again (request storm, no failure state).
fix: Track user full info as Fetch<UserFullInfo> per user with a Failed stage that stops re-asking until retry.

title: Join group note overwrites join_channel's own error, and 'Join request sent' is shown before any answer
trigger: Open a group with the Join / Apply to join bar while offline (join_channel returns Err), press the button.
effect: join_channel sets StatusNote::error('could not join'); press_bottom_action then sets set_note('Joining group'/'Join request sent') unconditionally, replacing it. User is told the request was sent when the send failed; success of the join is also never matched back.
fix: Have join_channel return the send result and let press_bottom_action set the note only on Ok.

title: Restart after Unblock is sent even when the unblock failed or was deduped
trigger: Bot chat blocked, press Restart while offline or while an unblock is already in flight.
effect: unblock_peer ignores its own result and always calls start_bot_from_bar when restart is set, so /start is sent to a still-blocked bot and the unblock error note is replaced by 'Starting bot'.
fix: Run the restart only on the Ok(Some) arm, or chain it on the unblock answer.

title: Add-bot and Share-game boxes close as if saved when the request was only queued
trigger: Profile of a bot > Add to group > pick chat > Add as admin, when the server later refuses (no right) ; or share a game to a chat the bot cannot post in.
effect: submit_add_bot/send_shared_game return true on Ok(Some)/Ok(_) (request queued), so the box closes and the chat is selected; the refusal only arrives later as a generic error. For Plan::Admin the start message is also sent right after the promote without waiting for its answer.
fix: Keep the box in a Sending stage and close on the answer matched by request id; send the start payload on promote ok.

title: Add-bot box shows 'Loading…' forever when the bot's full info never arrives
trigger: Open Add to group from a bot profile with fetch_user_full_info failing, or in a session without live.
effect: bot_invite_facts needs session.bots.bot_info for the bot; the fetch result is discarded (let _ =), and the box has no error or retry stage, only Cancel.
fix: Fetch<BotInfo> for the bot with a Failed arm and Retry in the box.

title: Opening Add-bot / Share-game by deep link replaces whatever ProfileDialog is open
trigger: Edit Contact box open with typed changes, click a t.me/<bot>?startgroup= or ?game= link.
effect: open_add_bot_dialog/open_share_game_dialog overwrite the single profile_dialog slot (EditContact, Birthday, ...) without closing or asking; the typed edits are lost and returning shows nothing.
fix: Queue the new box behind the open one or refuse while a ProfileDialog with edits is open.

title: HISTORY_AREA thread-local is shared by all windows and never cleared
trigger: Main window and a chat window both show outgoing gradient bubbles with different sizes, or a history without wallpaper layer paints after another window.
effect: note_history_area stores the last painted history's bounds; a bubble in another window (or a frame where the wallpaper layer did not report) slices its gradient from that stale area, so colours differ from what the window's own area gives.
fix: Key the area by window/history (pass it through the paint context) or clear it at the start of each frame.

title: Reassign click that fails to send leaves the boost box stuck in Working
trigger: Open boost box for a chat with no free slot, reach the Reassign list, tick a slot, click Reassign while the TDLib send fails (connection down / sender error)
effect: driver.reassign_boosts sets phase=Working, note=None, reassigning=Some(..) before send_boost_chat; on Err it returns without restoring, so the box shows the Main body with the Boost button loading+disabled and only Close left. The toast says it could not reassign but the box cannot retry or go back
fix: Set Working only after the send succeeds, or restore the previous phase (Reassign{..}) and clear reassigning on the Err arm (src/connect/groups/boost_flow.rs:61)

title: Boost flow stage is spread over BoostBoxState::phase, Groups::boost_intent, boost_slots_by_chat and request-purpose lookups
trigger: Press Boost, close the box, reopen, press again
effect: Stage 'boosting' is phase==Working AND boost_intent==Some(chat) AND a GetBoostSlotsForBoost/boostChat request in flight, kept in step by hand across close_boost_box, request_chat_boost and maybe_continue_boost; the loading text of the main body is a request lookup (has_purpose_for_chat) rather than a Fetch value
fix: One BoostFlow enum (Closed, Loading, Ready, Working{intent}, Reassign, Notice) owned by the box, with Fetch<BoostStatus> for the status

title: Stop-generating stage is can_stop/stopped/stop_failed plus a request lookup
trigger: Bot streams a reply; user presses Stop
effect: The stage Streaming/Stopping/Stopped/StopFailed is encoded by PendingBotMessage::{can_stop,stopped,stop_failed} (state/session.rs:13) and by has_purpose_for_chat(StopPendingMessage) in the view; finish_pending_bot_stop and the error arm flip them by hand
fix: enum StopStage { Streaming, Stopping(RequestId), Stopped, Failed } on PendingBotMessage

title: 'Could not stop the reply' stays on screen while a retry is Stopping
trigger: Press Stop, request fails (stop_failed=true), press Stop again
effect: stop_failed is cleared only in finish_pending_bot_stop; a new StopPendingMessage request does not clear it, so the row shows 'Stopping...' and 'Could not stop the reply' together until the stop succeeds
fix: Fold into a StopStage enum so entering Stopping leaves Failed (connect/bots.rs:688 stop_pending_bot_message sets Stopping)

title: Streaming rows hash changes every render for empty or rich drafts
trigger: Bot sends a draft with no text yet (Thinking placeholder) or a RichMessage draft in the open chat
effect: stream_rows_hash treats revealing = reveal.draft_id != draft.draft_id; StreamReveal::advance (which sets draft_id) runs only for non-empty Text drafts, so for an empty or Rich draft revealing stays true and the hash carries a fresh nanosecond tick each call: the history rows are rebuilt on every frame that renders for the whole life of the draft
fix: Derive 'revealing' from the draft content (Text with shown<total) not from draft_id equality, or have StreamReveal track the draft for every content kind

title: Create bot: dialog.submitted mirrors session create.creating and a 150 ms poll task drives it
trigger: Fill the dialog, press Create
effect: BotCreateDialog::submitted is set by hand and reset by poll_bot_create when CreateBotState::creating becomes None; created/error/creating/check_pending/check live in the Session and a spawn_screen timer loop polls them every 150 ms until settled
fix: One CreateStage enum (Editing, Creating, Failed(msg), Done(id)) in the dialog fed by the answer, no polling

title: Cancel while 'Creating...' loses the result of a createBot that then succeeds
trigger: Press Create, then Cancel (button stays enabled while submitted) before TDLib answers
effect: close_bot_create takes the dialog and reset_create_bot bumps CreateBotState::generation and clears creating; the late createBot answer no longer matches creating==Some(generation) (state/domains/bots/owned.rs:apply_created_bot), so the bot is created on the server but the user gets no toast, no chat and no share_users_with_bot for a keyboard-button request; retrying the same username then says taken
fix: Disable Cancel (or keep a Creating stage that outlives the box) so the answer still reports and shares the new bot

title: A poll task of a closed create dialog can finish a reopened dialog with the old name and username
trigger: Press Create, Cancel, reopen Create bot (another link/button) within 150 ms and press Create again
effect: The old poll task keeps its captured name/full and only checks bot_create_dialog.is_none(); with a new dialog present it keeps running and whichever poller sees created first closes the dialog, toasts and resolves the deep link with the old username
fix: Key the poller by a dialog token (like version) and stop when it differs, or drop polling for an answer-driven stage

title: Edit bot: dialog.filled plus session edit.name/about/load_failed plus a 150 ms fill loop
trigger: Open Edit bot for an owned bot
effect: BotEditDialog::filled says the fields hold the server texts and is set by a polling task (fill_bot_edit) from BotEditState::{name,about,load_failed}; Save enablement combines filled with the session state, and status text is a priority chain of load_failed/local_error/server_error/saving/saved/!loaded
fix: Fetch<BotEditTexts> in the dialog (Loading, Ready, Failed) filled by the answer; one SaveStage enum

title: Fill loop quits when no window can be updated, leaving the box 'Loading' with Save off
trigger: Open Edit bot, the opening window closes and the main window handle is unavailable (hidden/closed) before the texts arrive
effect: find_map returns None when neither window handle updates; 'filled != Some(false)' is true for None so the loop breaks and filled stays false forever; Save is disabled until the box is reopened
fix: Retry on None, or fill from the answer in the window that renders the box

title: Stale local error and sticky 'Saved' in the bot edit box
trigger: Save with a too-long name (local_error set), fix the text; or save once, then edit again
effect: local_error is cleared only by the next Save press, so the red error stays while the user fixes the field; edit.saved is a counter never reset by further edits, so 'Saved' keeps showing over unsaved changes
fix: Derive the status from the current field values and a SaveStage enum that goes back to Editing on change

title: START parameter is removed before TDLib confirms sendBotStartMessage
trigger: Open a bot via t.me/bot?start=param, press Start while the request will fail (flood, offline right after send)
effect: press_bot_start removes Session bots.bot_start_params[chat] as soon as the request is queued; the error arm only sets chat_action_error, so the Start bar and the parameter are gone and the bot is later started without the parameter or not at all
fix: Remove the parameter in the reducer on the sendBotStartMessage success (or keep a Starting{param} stage restored on error)

title: Similar bots fetch: UI inserts Loading next to the request, section shows the same button while loading
trigger: Press 'Similar bots' on a bot card
effect: SimilarBotsFetch::Loading is written by the UI after the driver queued the request and removed by the error arm of the reducer; the panel treats Loading like absent (same fetch button, no progress, 'Already loading' note on repeat), with the Loading entry and the pending request as two copies of one stage
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> set by the driver when it sends, with the view showing a spinner for Loading and Retry for Failed

title: Verify box returns to the list as if done before TDLib answers
trigger: Pick a chat, press Verify/Remove while TDLib will reject it (not allowed, flood)
effect: submit_bot_verify returns true once the request is sent, so the box goes back to Pick and shows a 'Verifying...' toast; the failure only sets chat_action_error elsewhere and the row stays unverified with no per-box error
fix: Add a Step::Sending(chat) that leaves on the answer and shows the error in the box

title: Closing the Business box drops the failed-send line of the screen it saved
trigger: Open Settings > Business > Away message, change it, press Esc (or the box's close button / backdrop) while the connection is down or the driver refuses the send. close_business_saving calls business_leave, whose business_send returns Leave::Go(Some("Could not send ...")); only Leave::Stay is looked at, so the Go note is dropped and the dialog closes. Same in demo mode (DEMO_LINE).
effect: The box closes as if the settings were saved; no toast, no status line. The edit is lost silently.
fix: Have close_business_saving post a StatusNote for Leave::Go(Some(line)) (as it does for Stay), or make Leave carry Saved / NotSent(line) and match both arms.

title: Esc/backdrop/close from a child screen discards the parent screen's unsaved draft
trigger: Hours > Monday (View::Day), Hours > Time zone, Greeting/Away/Chatbots > recipients picker, or Start page > Choose sticker (View::StickerPick): edit the title/message/hours, open the child screen, press Esc or click the backdrop. close_business_saving takes d.view (the child) and business_leave only saves Greeting|Away|Hours|Location|StartPage|Chatbots; the child view returns Leave::Go(None), then close_business drops the whole BusinessDialog.
effect: The typed start-page title/message, the edited opening hours, or the greeting/away/bot recipient changes are lost with no warning, although the module promises that Esc and the backdrop save the open screen.
fix: Close should save the owning screen: walk View::parent (or make View::{Day,TimeZone,Picker,StickerPick} carry their parent screen) and run business_leave for the root screen that owns the draft.

title: BusinessDialog: the open screen is `view` plus a set of Option drafts kept in step by hand
trigger: Navigation inside the box (business_go / business_back / route_business_start_page_sticker, which sets d.view directly): d.view must agree with which of greeting, away, hours, day_rows, location, picker, start_page, link_edit, chatbot is Some (View::Picker needs picker; View::Greeting with greeting None means 'Loading'; Hub clears seven drafts by hand; link_edit/confirm_delete reset in business_go; local_error and note are two Option<String> that can both be set).
effect: No wrong state found beyond P-002, but every new screen must edit business_go's reset list, business_draft_missing, business_fill_draft and business_leave in step.
fix: One enum Screen { Hub, Greeting(Fetch<GreetingDraft>), Away(..), Hours{draft, sub: HoursSub}, Location(..), StartPage{draft, sticker_pick: bool-free sub enum}, ChatLinks{edit}, Chatbots(..) } so a draft exists exactly while its screen does, and a child view is a variant of its parent's.

title: ChatbotDraft: bot stage is `loaded` bool + `committed` Option + `warning` + `confirm_leave` bool
trigger: Chatbots screen: the draft is made before the server's bot is known (loaded=false), then loaded=true, then a bot is committed (committed Some), a risky right sets warning, leaving with found-but-unadded bots sets confirm_leave. The stage is spread over four fields (loaded is already a baseline entry in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt) and reset by hand at chatbots.rs:107,214,406,448.
effect: No wrong state found in the files read; the 'loaded' flag has no failed arm in the struct (failed is derived from the session at chatbots.rs:147).
fix: enum BotStage { Loading, Failed(String), NoBot{username}, Connected{bot, rights, warning: Option<..>}, ConfirmLeave{..} } inside the Chatbots screen variant.

title: Settings > Calls spawns a fetch and notifies every frame while the sessions list stays idle
trigger: Open Settings > Calls while the session is not Authorization Ready or ShutdownPhase is not Running (for example while logging out, or the first moments after a reconnect), or while send_json fails. call_device_prefs_section runs in render; sessions.is_idle() is true, so it spawn_screen's a task that calls maybe_fetch_active_sessions (returns Err(InvalidRequest) before sessions.begin(), so the state stays Idle) and then cx.notify()s unconditionally when live is Some. The notify re-renders the section, which spawns again.
effect: A redraw plus task-spawn loop at frame rate for as long as the page is open and the fetch cannot start; CPU/battery drain.
fix: Start the fetch from upkeep keyed on the Fetch state (Idle -> Loading) and notify only when the request was actually sent (Ok(Some(_))); never notify from a no-op.

title: A failed call-window open is retried by every frame and posts its error each time
trigger: A call rings in (or is placed) and cx.open_window fails (display gone, OS refusal). open_call_window clears calls.window_opening and sets the 'Couldn't open the call window' note, but sets nothing that stops sync_call_window: wanted stays Some(id) with calls.window None, so the next sync_call_windows (the poll and every window's frame; the note/notify re-renders) calls open_call_window again.
effect: A loop of open attempts and repeated error toasts (a request/redraw loop) for the length of the call.
fix: Make the call window one enum (Closed, Opening, Open(handle), Failed(call_id)) so a failure records the call it failed for and sync does not retry until the call changes.

title: Call window linger: `ended_at` + `linger_wake` Option are an implicit 'ended, wake scheduled' machine
trigger: sync_call_window derives lingering from CallScreen::ended_at (id, Instant) and uses linger_wake: Option<i32> as a 'wake task already spawned for this call' flag, cleared by the task itself; plus calls.raised_for and calls.window_opening are further hand-kept stages of the same window.
effect: No wrong state found: the wake always clears itself and a switch replaces CallScreen; but a task dropped before it runs (app teardown) would leave the flag set.
fix: One CallWindowPhase enum: Hidden, Showing, Lingering{call_id, until}, ClosedByUser(call_id), with the wake owned by the Lingering variant (a stored Task dropped with it).

title: Background accounts get the raw window focus as app_active, not the lock-aware value the on-screen account gets
trigger: Have two accounts. Lock Quill with a passcode and leave its lock screen focused (or just use Quill in the foreground). A message or reaction arrives on the account that is not on screen.
effect: poll_background copies frame.window_active (OS focus of any Quill window) into every background session's app_active. decide_notification_sound and decide_reaction_notify return nothing while app_active is true, so the background account makes no sound and no reaction notification while Quill is locked but focused. poll_live uses !refused_while_locked() && main focus for the on-screen account, and lock-is-a-render-state.md section 4 says background sessions get the same value.
fix: One 'looked at' value (focus and not locked) computed in one place and used by poll_live and poll_background; a background account is never looked at, so consider false for it.

title: Lock-screen log out ignores Deletion::Done { error } and reconnects as if the wipe worked
trigger: Lock Quill, press Log out on the lock screen while one account folder cannot be deleted (file held open, permissions).
effect: The passcode is already forgotten (forget_passcode runs before the wipe). The done closure matches Deletion::Done { .. }, drops the error, clears wiping, calls disk_accounts_wiped and start_connection. The user sees a fresh sign-in with no note while the old account's data is still on disk until the next start.
fix: Handle Done { error: Some(_) } like Deferred: keep a note that the data is still there, and do not report the wipe as complete.

title: Autoscroll loop is not owned by the mode, so a stop then a quick new press runs two loops
trigger: Middle-click to start autoscroll, click to stop, and middle-click again within one 15 ms tick.
effect: The first spawn_scoped_in loop is still awaiting its timer. active is Some again (new anchor), so the old loop's autoscroll_plan returns a step and it keeps scrolling next to the new loop: double speed until the mode stops. The task is detached and not stored with Active.
fix: Hold the Task inside Active (dropped when active becomes None), or give Active a press token that the loop compares on each plan.

title: The active track is spread over playing_voice, playing_audio, player.chat, player.meta, seek_slider, track_length and the seek bools
trigger: Any play, stop, pause, finish or switch of a track.
effect: Two Options (voice and audio) that must never both be Some, plus chat/meta that must be Some exactly when one is, plus slider, track_length, seek_scrubbing, seek_preview_secs, seek_hover kept in step by begin_track_playback, stop_*_playback, clear_playback_state and release_player_chat. A caller that stops only one kind (demos/media.rs) clears the other's slider and length while its sound plays.
fix: One Option<ActiveTrack { kind, chat, message, meta, length, seek: SeekState }> where SeekState is an enum Idle | Hover | Scrubbing { preview }; stop drops it whole.

title: playback.tick and players.builds_watched are bools standing for 'a task runs'
trigger: Start a track (tick), or start the first non-simulated player (builds_watched).
effect: tick is set true before spawning and reset by the task's tail; the task's way out is 'no active track' only, a dropped continuation leaves it true (harmless today because the whole PlaybackUi is replaced with the screen). builds_watched is set once and never cleared. tick_shown is an Option that is also reset by hand with it.
fix: Store the tick as Option<Task> (or enum TickState { Off, Running { shown } }) in PlaybackUi so dropping it ends the loop and clears the flag.

title: Seek slider events are not matched to the track whose slider sent them
trigger: Start dragging the row's seek slider, then switch tracks (media key Next, or another row) before releasing.
effect: The subscription made in begin_track_playback is detached and never checks which slider fired. The old slider entity is held by the element during the drag, so its Release calls seek_active_to with the old value on the new track and moves it to a wrong position.
fix: Compare the event's entity to self.playback.seek_slider (or keep the subscription in the ActiveTrack so it drops with it) before applying.

title: Registration form is cleared when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: On the sign-up step enter a name, accept the terms, press Create Account; the server rejects it (invalid name, flood) and auth stays WaitRegistration.
effect: submit_registration clears first and last name and accepted_registration_terms on a successful send; the answer is an error, the form is empty and the terms checkbox is unticked again, so the user retypes everything. submit_email does the same for the email (auth_ui.rs:44).
fix: Clear on the accepted answer (auth leaves WaitRegistration), or keep the values and only clear when the step changes.

title: recovery_mode is set when the recovery request is sent, before the server accepts it
trigger: On the 2FA password step press Forgot password? and the server refuses (too many requests).
effect: The screen switches to recovery-code entry and says the code was sent. The error arrives later as last_auth_error; the user waits for an email that never comes (Resend and Back are the only ways out).
fix: Make the password step an enum PasswordStep { Password, RecoveryRequested { request }, RecoveryCode } and move to RecoveryCode on the answer.

title: Terms prompt is terms_step plus terms_age_ok plus terms_age_error
trigger: Terms of service box: tick the age box, press Agree without it, press Decline, Back.
effect: Three fields describe one prompt: the step enum, a bool for the ticked age and a bool for the shown error. They are written from three click handlers in dialogs/account_notices.rs and reset nowhere except the checkbox handler.
fix: enum TermsStep { Terms { age_ok: bool, age_error: bool }, DeclineSorry, DeleteWarning } on a Option<TermsPrompt> that exists only while notices.terms is Some.

title: Terms prompt state outlives the terms it was about
trigger: Tick the age box and Agree (or leave the prompt at DeclineSorry or DeleteWarning by closing it some other way). A later terms update arrives in the same session.
effect: terms_age_ok stays true and terms_step stays where it was, so the new terms open with the age already confirmed (or on the sorry/delete step) and Agree skips the age check.
fix: Own the prompt state in an Option created when notices.terms becomes Some and dropped when it becomes None.

title: recovery_mode and accepted_registration_terms are reset by poll_live when auth changes, not by the auth stage
trigger: Auth moves away from WaitPassword or WaitRegistration (any path).
effect: Two UI values are valid only in one authorization state; notifications/mod.rs:467-480 clears them by hand each poll. A path that changes auth without that poll code (a restart of the connection, a screen replacement) relies on OnScreen being rebuilt.
fix: Keep step-specific UI in an enum keyed by the authorization state, rebuilt when the state changes.

title: BackgroundAccounts keeps the lifecycle of each account in several sets, counters and bools
trigger: Starting, closing, removing, wiping or restarting accounts.
effect: starting (set), preparing (counts), closing (ClosingSet), deleting (set), clients (Vec with live Option and status), plus polling, wiping, swept and screen_preparing are all read together in ensure_background_accounts, deletion_wait, open_wait and startup_sweep. An account's stage (Preparing, Starting, Running, Closing, Deleting, Failed) is the combination of its membership in these. The polling bool is also the 'a poll task runs' flag.
fix: HashMap<AccountKey, AccountStage> with an enum (Preparing, Starting, Running(LiveConnect), Closing{restart}, Deleting, NeedsSignIn/Failed) so every check is one match; polling as Option<Task>.

title: A background account that failed to start keeps a dead client entry that nothing retries
trigger: finish_background_start gets a non-DiskFull blocker (keychain read fails once) or the bridge stops unexpectedly.
effect: The entry stays with live None and status Failed; ensure_background_accounts skips any key that has a client entry, so the account gets no notifications or unread count until Quill restarts or the account is switched to.
fix: Make Failed a stage with a retry exit (on the next ensure pass or an explicit retry), instead of an entry that blocks the start.

title: Report spam with unarchive also leaves the chat
trigger: Archived group shows a ReportSpam bar with can_unarchive: the button reads 'Report spam' (no leave). Press it and confirm OK.
effect: submit_bar_report always calls leave_channel after report_chat, so the user silently leaves the group/channel; for a private chat leaveChat is wrong or errors and the note says the report failed although it went out.
fix: Carry the bar variant into the confirm: an enum ReportSpamAction { ReportOnly, ReportAndLeave } chosen when the button is built and passed to submit_bar_report.

title: Apply sends part of a plan, reports failure, and a pack request is not tracked as busy
trigger: Change name colour and group emoji pack in a supergroup, Apply. Name request goes out, then set_supergroup_custom_emoji_sticker_set refuses (no rights / full info missing) and returns Err.
effect: Part of the plan is already applied but the note says could not change and dialog.sent=false. Conversely when the pack request is sent, busy covers only three purposes, so 'Appearance updated' shows while the pack request is in flight and its error never reaches appearance_error.
fix: Validate the whole plan before sending any part, and make the Apply stage one enum (Editing, NeedsBoosts, Applying{requests}, Applied, Failed(reason)) that counts all four request purposes.

title: Appearance Apply stage is sent + needs_boosts + session busy + session error
trigger: Open the Appearance box, Apply, edit, Apply again.
effect: The visible stage (Applying, Applied, Failed, NeedsBoosts, Editing) is derived from dialog.sent, dialog.needs_boosts, requests.has_purpose_for_chat and the session-wide chats_state.appearance_error, kept in step by hand in edit_chat_appearance and apply_chat_appearance.
fix: One ApplyStage enum on the dialog; the error is stored in the variant, matched to the chat and request ids.

title: Old Apply error stays after editing the draft; error is not tied to a chat
trigger: Apply a change that TDLib refuses (not enough boosts server side). Error line shows. Change a swatch.
effect: edit_chat_appearance resets sent and needs_boosts but not the session-wide appearance_error, so the stale refusal stays under the new draft until the next Apply. The error is also unkeyed by chat: a late refusal for chat A shows in the box opened for chat B.
fix: Store the error in the Apply stage enum with the chat id and request id; clear it when the draft changes.

title: Boost-level message for the wallpaper is written into the shared background_error
trigger: In a boosted supergroup open Appearance > Choose wallpaper, pick a wallpaper the chat has too few boosts for, Apply (blocked), close the box, open Settings > Wallpapers.
effect: boosted_look_blocked writes chats_state.background_error, which wallpaper_preview and telegram_wallpapers also render, so 'Level N required' or 'Checking the boost level' shows on unrelated pages and is only cleared by the next open/apply of one of them.
fix: Keep the gate message in the chat look dialog's own state (a variant of its Apply stage), not in the session-wide background error.

title: Permission continuation re-runs a plain starter and is not matched to the ask
trigger: On macOS with the microphone undetermined, press Answer on a ringing call twice (or toggle the call camera twice) while the system prompt is up, then allow.
effect: Each press spawns a poller; after the grant each runs the starter. answer_call runs accept_call twice (second gives 'Could not answer the call'), flip_call_camera flips twice (camera ends off). If the caller hung up or another call rings meanwhile, answer_call accepts whatever call is tracked now, not the one asked.
fix: A PermissionAsk { what, call_id } value held in one Option; a second press while it is Some is ignored and the continuation checks the same call id is still current before starting.

title: Call window is window Option + window_opening bool (+ raised_for, window_closed_by_user)
trigger: Press the call bar to open the call window; close it; second call rings.
effect: Closed / Opening / Open is spread over CallUi::window, CallUi::window_opening (set before cx.defer, cleared in the deferred body) and the screen's window_closed_by_user and raised_for. A deferred body that does not run leaves Opening forever; same shape for tick_active (call tick) and linger_wake.
fix: enum CallWindow { Closed, Opening, Open(handle) } and enum Tick { Idle, Running } owned by CallUi.

title: dialing ticket is separate from the permission wait and stays Some on refusal
trigger: On macOS deny the microphone prompt when pressing Call.
effect: dial_user sets call_boxes.dialing before with_capture_access; only dial_allowed takes it. A refusal or a dropped continuation leaves it Some until the next dial or a switch. Two Call presses during one prompt share the single ticket, so the second silently does nothing.
fix: Put the ticket in the permission-ask enum (see with_device_access) so the refusal and the drop clear it.

title: VolumePill is four held bools plus closes_at; leave/Release events can be lost
trigger: Start dragging the live story volume slider, then the stream ends (slider slot set to None) or the viewer closes while the pointer is over the pill; reopen a live story.
effect: dragging/toggle/pill/keyboard are set by events on elements that can vanish before the matching leave or Release arrives (stream_volume_slider clears the slot, LiveStoryUi outlives the viewer). The pill then reads held() and stays open for the next live story.
fix: Reset volume_pill when the slider slot is cleared and when the story viewer is released, or derive 'held' from a single PillState enum.

title: slow_mode_tick_chat is an Option used as a 'task started' flag
trigger: Open a slow-mode chat X, open slow-mode chat Y, return to X within one second.
effect: The Option names one chat while the tasks are one per start; X to Y to X starts a second task for X while the first still loops (double notify each second). The flag is only cleared by the task itself.
fix: Keep the tick as a stored Task owned by the composer (dropped on chat change) instead of a name guard.

title: Join-requests box spins forever when the first fetch or a search cannot be sent
trigger: Open the join-requests box (or type in its search) while the request cannot be sent: refresh_chat_join_requests / search_chat_join_requests return Err (removes groups.join_requests[chat]) or Ok(None) (not ready, entry never created). The results of both calls are dropped with `let _ =`.
effect: build_join_requests_dialog maps `None | Some(Loading)` to the spinner 'Loading join requests', so the box shows a spinner with no way out and no error note; closing and reopening is the only exit.
fix: Make the box read a Fetch-like value with an explicit Failed/Idle arm: on Err or Ok(None) store JoinRequestFetch::Failed(message) (and show a note) so None means 'not asked', not 'loading'.

title: 'Show more' join requests drops its error and a refused send
trigger: Click 'Show more' while another page is in flight (load_more returns Ok(None)) or the send fails (Err).
effect: Nothing happens and no note shows; the button looks dead.
fix: Report Err as a StatusNote and disable the button while join_request_latest is set (derive it from the Fetch stage).

title: Add-all / Dismiss-all confirm alert outlives its account and uses a stale count
trigger: Open the join-requests box, click 'Add all', leave the kit alert open, switch account (or the list changes from another device), press OK.
effect: on_ok calls process_all_join_requests(chat_id, approve) on whatever live account is current (a chat id of the old account), and the confirm text shows the count captured when the box was rendered.
fix: Open the confirm through a registered DialogKind owned by OnScreen (closed by the switch) and re-read count/chat on OK, checking ScreenEpoch.

title: Header menu entries are built for one chat but run on whichever chat is open at click time
trigger: Open the chat header menu (entries built in chat_navigation_menu for chat A), then open chat B (notification click, Alt+Down, link) or switch account while the popup is still showing, and click Report / Auto-Delete / Close Secret Chat / Statistics.
effect: run_header_entry re-reads session.open_chat instead of using the chat_id the entries were computed for, so the action (report box, TTL picker, close-secret-chat confirm, wallet, boost) targets chat B, and with an account switch the old account's entry list runs against the new account.
fields: chat_navigation_menu closure captures `discussion` but not chat_id
fix: Capture ChatId (an AccountChat owner key) and ScreenEpoch in the menu closure and drop the click when session.open_chat != captured.

title: DropOnRow holds a file-drag / forward-drag / preview mode as eight fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Any drag over the chat list: hover, position, paths, drag, rest, frozen, unfreeze, forward, in_list and preview are set and cleared in different handlers (drag_left, end_forward_drag, drop_*, over=false branches).
effect: No bug today beyond the ones listed; every new handler must clear the right subset (clear() resets all, over=false resets only hover/rest).
fix: enum ListDrag { Idle, Files{hover,position,paths,drag,rest}, Forward{drag,in_list,hover}, Preview } with the freeze (frozen + unfreeze) as one Option<Freeze>.

title: A file drag's one-second 'open the chat' timer can fire for a later forward drag
trigger: Drag files over row A (timer armed), cancel the drag without an exit event reaching the list (Esc), and start a forward drag from a history that rests on row A within one second.
effect: choose_row_by_drag checks only hover == chat and cx.has_active_drag() (true for the forward drag), so the chat opens although forward drags never open by resting (_dragForward); forward_over_row does not cancel `rest`.
fix: Fold into the ListDrag enum so entering the Forward variant drops the Files variant and its timer.

title: Cached drag classification is reused for the next drag with the same paths
trigger: Drag a file over the list, cancel, change what the path holds (empty the folder, delete the file), drag the same path again.
effect: same_paths() sees equal paths so fresh is None and the old DragState is kept; the row lights up (or refuses) by the old probe and drop_on_row attaches by the old kind (Folder vs Files).
fix: Clear paths/drag when the drag ends or leaves (drag_left/over=false/drop) so each drag probes again.

title: Topic chooser load stage is DropTopic::load_failed plus two session sets
trigger: Drop files on a forum row: the stage is load_failed (bool, in the baseline) OR threads.forum_topics_failed.contains(chat) OR forum_topics.contains_key(chat) OR bot_topics.is_some(), combined in drop_topic_failed/drop_topic_loaded/drop_topic_choices.
effect: load_failed never clears when topics later arrive; a failure that is retried shows 'could not load' only while choices are empty. No stuck state found.
fix: Hold Fetch<()> for the topics in DropTopic (Loading/Ready/Failed) written from the same answer, instead of a bool beside session sets.

title: Dropped files or messages vanish silently when the chat does not open after the topic is picked
trigger: Drop files on a forum row, pick a topic; select_listed_chat is refused (agent_may_open false, route_chat_open returns None) or the forum has no window and the chat does not become open.
effect: choose_drop_topic has already set drop_topic = None and the box closes; enter_drop_topic returns false without a note on the 'chat not open' path, so the payload (paths or forward draft) is discarded with no feedback.
fix: Keep the payload until the open succeeds (a Choosing -> Opening -> Done enum) and set an error note on the false path.

title: Choosing a folder or entering community mode while the Calls tab is open leaves the Calls tab showing
trigger: Open the Calls tab, then click a folder in the folder rail (open_folder_tab) or 'View chats' in the community hub (enter_community_chat_list_mode).
effect: Both clear contacts_tab_open but not calls_tab_open, so sidebar_ready keeps drawing the calls list; the folder/community filter changes underneath with no visible effect.
fix: enum SidebarTab { Chats, Contacts, Calls } set in one function; the folder and community starters set Chats.

title: Sidebar tab is two bools, 'mutually exclusive' only by convention
trigger: open_chats_tab/open_contacts_tab/open_calls_tab, archive_row.rs:114, the demos and open_folder_tab each set a different subset of contacts_tab_open and calls_tab_open.
effect: Bug above; the pair can hold (true,true) from any future writer that forgets the other.
fix: enum SidebarTab { Chats, Contacts, Calls } in ChatListUi.

title: Pinned-row drag is pin_reorder + pin_reorder_archived + pin_press + preview_press + preview
trigger: Mouse down on a pinned row sets pin_press (chat_row), the first drag move builds pin_reorder and clears preview/preview_press, release keeps pin_reorder for the slide, render drops it when settled.
effect: pin_reorder_archived is only meaningful while pin_reorder is Some; pin_press survives clicks that never drag.
fix: enum RowPress { None, Pressed{chat,y}, Peek{..}, Reordering{archived, reorder} } owned by ChatListUi.

title: Pinned drag with a lost mouse-up never ends and redraws at 60 Hz
trigger: Start dragging a pinned chat and release the mouse outside the window, or lose the release to a menu/alert/window deactivation, so neither on_mouse_up nor on_mouse_up_out on #chat-rows fires.
effect: PinReorder::animating() stays true while dragging is Some, so sidebar_chats never clears it and calls request_animation_tick(60) every frame; the list stays in the swapped order and the grabbing cursor stays. The `!window_active && dragging().is_none()` escape does not cover the dragging case.
fix: Cancel the reorder on drag end/cancel (GPUI drag-ended hook), window deactivation and Esc; treat Reordering as an enum stage with those exits.

title: Pinned order is sent from the ids snapshotted at drag start
trigger: Start dragging a pinned chat, meanwhile unpin another chat (or pin one) on another device, then release.
effect: finish_pin_drag sends set_pinned_chat_order(archived, reorder.ids) built from the pre-drag list, re-pinning the chat that was unpinned (or dropping the new pin); an Err leaves the displayed order until the slide settles with only a note.
fix: Re-read session.pinned_chat_ids at release and reapply the dragged move to it; reject the drop when the set differs.

title: Bulk pin passes the pin-limit pre-check for every chat because the session count lags the in-flight requests
trigger: Select 5 chats with 2 free pin slots and press Pin: toggle_selected_pins calls toggle_chat_pin per chat; each pre-check counts only server-confirmed pins.
effect: Five setPinned requests are sent; the extra ones fail on the server, each with its own note overwriting the previous (set_note), so the user sees one or no error and a partly pinned result with the selection already cleared.
fix: Count the requested-but-unanswered pins in the pre-check (pending pin set in the session) and stop the batch with the limit box at the first refusal.

title: Bulk delete confirm deletes the selection as it is at OK time, not what the box was opened for
trigger: Select 3 chats, press Delete, and while the confirm is open one of them is archived/left from another device or the list changes; press OK.
effect: RemoveSelectedChats re-reads selected_chat_ids() at submit (open_custom_title_dialog.rs:178), so the set deleted differs from the set the user confirmed (the box shows no count), and selection is cleared whatever the sends returned.
fix: Carry the confirmed Vec<ChatId> (OfAccount keys) in the confirm stage and delete exactly those; show the count in the text.

title: chat_list.items is a render-time cache read by key stepping while another pane is drawn
trigger: Open the Contacts or Calls tab or the search results (sidebar_chats not run), then press Alt+Down / Ctrl+Tab, or drag files over a row.
effect: step_open_chat, rows_selecting and freeze_list read chat_list.items from the last chats render, so stepping uses a list that is not on screen.
fix: Derive the stepping list from the same listing function the render uses (or clear items when the chats pane is not drawn).
